easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Shield Sphere.
You control at least one additional creature,
description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying its mana cost.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Shield Sphere and one other creature you control, returning Shield Sphere from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
